description: The handyai.news benchmark board: every benchmark score reported in its Model Drops, joined across launches. Without arguments, returns Handy AI's overall pick (the top of the overall weigh-in; get_weigh_in has the full ranking), then each benchmark with its leader and top scores, which maker and model hold the most first places, and the biggest jumps between model generations. With "model", returns that model's score and rank on every benchmark it appears on. Call get_benchmark for one benchmark's full leaderboard and history.

maker.description: Only benchmarks led by this maker, e.g. "Anthropic". Case-insensitive, partial match.

model.description: Only this model's scores, e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5" or "GPT-6 Astra".

range.description: Only scores from Model Drops published in this window. Default: all.

name: list_benchmarks
